query:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST($2::uuid []) AS ids(id)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM course_modules cm
        WHERE cm.id = ids.id
          AND cm.course_id = $1
          AND cm.deleted_at IS NULL
      )
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST($3::uuid []) AS ids(id)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM chapters c
        WHERE c.id = ids.id
          AND c.course_id = $1
          AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      )
  ) AS "all_belong!"
